title: [4.5] Drop 2 glb files, editor reports error "Attempted to call reimport_files() recursively, this is not allowed."
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5 stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.6.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Method 1:
Drop 2 glb files into FileSystem in Editor will trigger "Attempted to call reimport_files() recursively, this is not allowed."

Method 2:
Copy paste 2 glb files into project folder via OS file explorer (e.g. Finder on macOS), same error will be triggered.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new empty project.
2. Drop attached 2 glb files into editor's FileSystem.

Below are the 2 glb files I'm using.

[2glb_files.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22399208/2glb_files.zip)
